key_news.headline: S&P Global to Present at BofA Securities Information and Business Services Conference
key_news.summary: Mark Grant, SVP of Investor Relations and Treasurer, will participate in the BofA Securities conference in New York. Key investor event for 2026 guidance visibility.

key_news.headline: SPGI slides 3.8% amid risk-off tape
key_news.summary: Stock declined driven by positioning and macro risk-off sentiment rather than company-specific headlines. Investors repricing after February outlook and medium-term narrative.

key_news.headline: S&P Global Publishes Bitcoin Market Dynamics Research
key_news.summary: Published 'Bitcoin Volatility Trends: A Deep Dive into Market Dynamics and Risk', examining bitcoin's evolution from niche asset to one with meaningful linkages to traditional financial markets.

key_news.headline: S&P Global presents at Raymond James 47th Annual Institutional Investors Conference
key_news.summary: CEO Martina Cheung and CFO Eric Aboaf spoke in a webcast fireside chat in Orlando, Florida. Key executive visibility event.

key_news.headline: Director Hubert Joly purchases 2,500 shares worth ~$997K
key_news.summary: Notable insider buy by board member signals confidence in company outlook. Purchased at ~$399/share average.

key_news.headline: S&P Global files 10-K Annual Report for FY2025
key_news.summary: Annual report filed with SEC (accession: 0000064040-26-000013) for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Accepted February 11, 2026.

key_news.headline: SPGI stock drops after Q4 earnings and 2026 guidance disappoint
key_news.summary: Shares plunged after weak 2026 EPS guidance and Q4 earnings miss. Company guided organic constant-currency revenue growth of 6-8% for 2026.

key_news.headline: Mobility Global announces new brand name ahead of spinoff
key_news.summary: S&P Global Mobility rebrands to Mobility Global in preparation for mid-2026 tax-free spinoff. Portfolio includes CARFAX, automotiveMastermind, Polk Automotive Solutions, Market Scan.

key_news.headline: William Eager (President, S&P Global Mobility) purchases shares
key_news.summary: Mobility segment president purchased 23.03 shares at $517.58, modest purchase but signals alignment with spinoff company.

key_news.headline: S&P Global completes sale of EDM and thinkFolio businesses to STG
key_news.summary: Completed divestiture of Enterprise Data Management and thinkFolio businesses to private equity firm STG, further streamlining portfolio ahead of Mobility spinoff.

key_news.headline: Quarterly dividend of $0.97/share payable
key_news.summary: New annualized dividend rate of $3.88 per share. Dividend payable March 11, 2026.
